name: Christina Baldwin
reason: No longer teaches: her own sites say PeerSpirit (her circle and writing seminars with Ann Linnea) closed at the end of 2022 and the Circle Way was handed on from 2016; christinabaldwin.com now presents her as a novelist (The Beekeeper's Question) offering only 'emeritus mentoring', with no current courses, retreats or classes. Email christina@christinabaldwin.com is published on https://christinabaldwin.com/contact/ (base Freeland, Washington) if the owner wants her listed as an author anyway.
